generations.prompt:
Create one original landscape 16:9 bitmap background plate for an existing side-on versus fighting game arena. Native wide output. One single coherent physical room, no panels, no collage, no UI. Exact scene: Silent Hill 4: The Room, first visit to Building World, the large EMPTY stairwell from B12 down to B15 with the huge ventilation fan above it. This is the original first-pass stairwell, not the second visit, not an elevator shaft, not the rooftop, not a shop, not the bar itself and not Water Prison. No people, monsters, wheelchairs, corpses, writing, signage, logos, symbols, weapons or furniture.

SOURCE BASIS: The existing specialized walkthrough explicitly says a large empty stairwell with a huge fan above, descending B12 to B15. The licensed Piggyback guide printed page 101, figure 12, shows the familiar descending stair passage as stained desaturated green-brown masonry, broad worn steps, plain metal handrails and heavy shadow. That guide capture is a second-visit view used only to inform persistent masonry and stair material; exclude all entities and second-visit events. The exact fan blade count, its orientation and this wider combat camera are an authored candidate, not an exact source copy.

CAMERA / GEOMETRY: Fixed wide side-on versus framing, modest perspective into one tall enclosed dirty masonry stairwell. Give the foreground a broad continuous horizontal worn concrete landing spanning the full width of the image, bottom 30% completely empty and unobstructed for fighting. This landing is an explicit versus adaptation. Behind the landing, a broad staircase with plain aged iron railings descends diagonally away to the left rear into darkness. Stairwell walls rise high on left and right, stained damp gray-green concrete/masonry, subtle vertical industrial structure, no elaborately invented machinery. A single huge circular industrial ventilation fan is mounted high at the rear above the staircase, centered around x=50%, y=23%, diameter approximately 29% of image width. Its heavy dark metal round frame and a restrained few broad dark blades read clearly against muted recess shadow; blades remain static with no motion blur. It must look physically part of the tall stairwell, not a portal, decorative emblem or turbine engine. Main light is soft green-gray environmental spill from above; dim brown oxidation on rails, dark lower stair flight, restrained grime. Keep the center fighting space visually quiet, neither pitch black nor luminous. Do not add exposed sky, overhead boiler pipes, a dramatic low ceiling, fire, water, fog, smoke, falling material, doors, windows, bars across the fighter area, ladders, chains, or a drop on the foreground landing. Detailed serious psychological-horror game environment, muted desaturated green-gray, rusty brown and charcoal, believable scale, modest grain, not photoreal marketing, not cartoon. Opaque full frame, no transparency. No foreground edge framing pieces; those will be a separate PNG.

generations.prompt:
Derive a separate transparent FOREGROUND PARALLAX PLATE matching the attached background, at exactly the same wide landscape 16:9 canvas and camera perspective. The final image must be an RGBA PNG with genuine alpha transparency everywhere except very narrow near-camera masonry wall returns at the extreme left and right edge. This is an independent layer, NOT another room image.

Match the desaturated green-gray stained concrete/masonry and dim light of this Silent Hill 4 Building World first-visit stairwell. Remove the entire supplied image to transparency, including all walls, stairs, floor, fan, railings, shadows and light washes. Only show a close cropped vertical worn masonry corner on the outermost left 0–3% of canvas and another on the outermost right 97–100%; their maximum inner extent is 4% of width at either edge. Each is a thin irregular corner return continuous offscreen above and below, with believable small chips and subtle grayed stain texture. No new objects, no pipes, door frames, warning stripes, signage, bars, horizontal railing, massive columns or sculpted detail. Match the source masonry scale and dull soft overhead lighting. The inner edges should be softly antialiased but clean, with no smoky fade or dark rectangle behind them. These are NOT a decorative picture border. Do not connect the two sides at the top or bottom.

Every pixel in the central 90% of the canvas width must be fully transparent, including the floor region. No horizontal bottom strip, ground shadow, vignette, glow, fan, steps, smoke, fog, character, text or logo. Preserve the empty wide canvas and exact full-canvas alignment to the background so the pair can be placed at [0,0,1,1] with only ±1.2% width of camera parallax. These narrow edge returns should never cover the combat area.

proposedManifestEntry.notes: Grand escalier B12–B15 sous le ventilateur, premier Building World de SH4. Chambre vide sans fauteuils de la seconde visite. Matières et volée d’escalier informées par une capture de la seconde visite, sans importer ses entités ou événements. Palier horizontal, caméra, proportions, orientation frontale et quatre pales du ventilateur sont des adaptations non certifiées. Fond natif1672×941 et avant-plan natif1671×941, inchangés ; parallaxe de caméra .012. Aucun plafond déclaré, aucune chute, règle matérielle, cadence source ou fidélité 1:1 revendiquée.
